rows.name: n_crosslinks
rows.description: Number of NC1/7S crosslink bonds (total minus intra-rod); the readout that distinguishes remodeling from frozen.

rows.name: sigma_inplane
rows.description: Bond-virial in-plane stress; reported for the remodeling mode (finite) as a supporting readout.

rows.name: network_area
rows.description: Network area expansion -- a Fig-2B-C readout that needs the material-insertion process to be meaningful. Deferred (composite gap).

rows.name: largest_connected_network
rows.description: Size of the largest connected component (Fig-2B-C connectivity readout). Deferred -- needs the insertion mode to differentiate the three supply modes.
